brand_context.name: STAY
brand_context.offering: Adaptive independent-living and trusted-Circle coordination across daily routines, help requests, Safety Windows, playbooks, and incidents.
brand_context.industry: Accessible independent living and household coordination
brand_context.positioning: Calm civic wayfinding that keeps the resident in control without surveillance or emergency-service claims.
brand_context.audience: Older adults, disabled residents, trusted family and helpers, and coordinators.

concept.name: A clear way home
concept.visual_premise: A protected threshold and an unmistakable route forward, rendered as civic wayfinding rather than a technology-startup badge.
research_principles: The mark must remain legible at 24 pixels.
The silhouette must survive maskable-icon cropping.
The identity must avoid surveillance, medical, emergency-dispatch, and generic AI symbolism.
avoid: sparkles, stars, magic, glow, gradients, 3D, shadows, or generic AI motifs
hearts, hands, people, faces, shields, medical crosses, checkmarks, keys, pins, chat bubbles, brains, circuits, infinity loops, or roof outlines
letters, initials, wordmarks, taglines, borders, presentation boards, mockups, photography, or watermarks

logo.source: Higgsfield Recraft V4.1 selected from three 2K vector candidates

forbidden: emergency red in the core identity

layout.margins: generous optical padding and maskable safe area

composition.hierarchy: one isolated symbol with a strong 24-pixel silhouette
composition.text_behavior: no text in the symbol generation stage
